tests: F2 and Enter with the name unchanged, or changed only in case, is refused as an invalid name
steps:
1. In Project Explorer, select Sources/Helpers/Thing2.twin (a file not open in a tab) and press F2, then Enter with the name unchanged: the notification Cannot rename: the new name entered is invalid.
2. F2 again, type thing2.twin, Enter: the same notification; the file keeps the name Thing2.twin.
Control: F2 and a new name renames a file.
